warnings: 15 Synthesis Cards were drafted covering all six primary patterns (decision_process 2, constraint_structure 2, operational_tradeoff 3, operating_regime_change 3, historical_operation_failure 3, operational_consequence 2), drawing on 81 validated Knowledge Cards and their supporting Evidence Units rather than re-reading all 442 EUs directly for every candidate relationship.

7 of 15 cards were marked evidence_depth=source_checked_with_direct_quote after rereading the underlying source text for their most quantitative, causal, or historical claims (SC-LP-001, 003, 005, 009, 011, 012, 014); the remaining 8 cards are marked eu_only and rely on the already source-grounded Evidence Unit quotes and locators recorded during Evidence extraction rather than an independent full-document reread.

Several cards reuse EU/KC pairs already linked in one Knowledge Card (e.g., the 2026 drought-response EUs appear in both SC-LP-001 and SC-LP-009) because the same evidence supports more than one operational relationship (a decision-process view and a regime-change view); this is intentional cross-referencing, not duplication of a single claim.
unresolved_issues: SC-LP-006 (extended-duration HFE volume-protection override) and SC-LP-010 (post-2026 Basic Coordination Alternative continuity) document policy-level or inferred relationships that this EU/KC set does not confirm with a specific observed real-world instance; both are flagged with confidence=medium and an explicit next_step to find corroborating instance-level evidence.

SC-LP-014 (projected 2026-2027 elevation recovery) is a forward-looking projected_consequence card; it should be revisited once a post-April-2026 24-Month Study is available to confirm whether the projected 54-foot elevation rise was realized.
